title: Sign predicate
statement: A sign predicate consists of an arity $k\in\mathbb N$ and a Boolean-valued acceptance rule on $k$ signs; that is, a function from sign-valued $k$-tuples to $\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$.
